entry.title: My Bangalore Food Map
entry.content:
Places I've eaten in Bangalore and whether they're worth another visit.

A little food notebook for Bangalore, collecting the places I’ve visited and rated out of five. I’ll keep adding to it as I eat my way through the city 😋

📝 Note: This is also an experiment, I might spin this into a separate maps collection.

Name Neighborhood Rating Note
Burma Burma Indiranagar ★★★★★ One of my all time favourites in the city. I've gone back multiple times. Lotus Biscoff Bubble Tea is a must!
Toit Indiranagar ★★★★★ Great food, great drinks, great vibe. One of my favourite places to hang out. Their english breakfast is a must.
Cafe Grey Indiranagar ★★★★★ Good food and ambience, affordable spot to work from. I'm a regular here.
Brott Indiranagar ★★★★½ Limited items and overhyped but their drinks are great. My favourite is the Coconut Cloud Coffee. Seating is cramped.
Beyondburg Indiranagar ★★★★☆ Expensive but good burger selection. Good for once in a while. I recommend the Smashstrami burger.
Brik Oven New Thippasandra ★★★☆☆ Overhyped but decent food. There are better places to eat in the area.
The Pizza Bakery Indiranagar ★★★★☆ Their garlic bread is a must try. Overall good pizza selection.
Rumi Indiranagar ★★☆☆☆ The dishes recommended by the staff were very bad. I don't recommend this place.
23rd Street Pizza Ashok Nagar ★★☆☆☆ All of the dishes were average at best. Skip this place.
Element 3 Indiranagar ★★★½☆ Great north indian pure veg restaurant. I really like their kofta curry.
Azuki Bistro Richmond Town ★★★★☆ The ambience, food and service are great. I recommend trying out their desserts.
Chin Lung Brewery Indiranagar ★½☆☆☆ Good for a bar scene but the food is below average. Go only if you want to get drunk.
Tandoori Taal Indiranagar ★★★☆☆ Some dishes are good but some aren't. I'll keep it in my list for the occasional visit.
Nagarjuna Indiranagar ★★★★☆ Nice andhra cuisine restaurant. Their biryanis are great.
California Burrito Indiranagar ★★★★★ A cult classic in the city. My favourite is the Chilli Chipotle Chicken Burrito.
Qissa Indiranagar ★★☆☆☆ Average food taste in terms of Mediterranean cuisine. I won't go back here.
The Fresh Factory Indiranagar ★★★★★ They have some really delicious and healthy food but very expensive. A must try though, try out their French Toast.
The Veg & Veg Indiranagar ★★★★☆ Regular after run breakfast spot. They have a nice selection of item.
Milano Pizza Indiranagar ★★★☆☆ Good for when you want to find something to eat at 12 AM. Their almond cake is good!
The Srirangam Cafe Indiranagar ★★★½☆ Biased but this is my goto spot for tea and snacks!
Pizza 4P's Indiranagar ★★★★★ Amazing food especially the burrata cheese pizza. Their tiramisu is my favourite!
Kake Di Hatti Indiranagar ★★★☆☆ Decent food for north indian cuisine. I don't go here anymore.
Kailash Parbat Indiranagar ★☆☆☆☆ I had a bad experience here including food poisoning. I don't recommend this place.
Foo Brigade Road ★★★★☆ Overhyped but good food. It's also very expensive, I'm taking 1 star off for that.
Bamey's Gastro Bar Koramangala ★★★★☆ Their food is amazing more so if you like Nepalese food. The jhol momos are a must try!
Truffles Indiranagar ★★★½☆ The sandwiches and pasta here are great. Good for a quick bite.
Umesh Refreshments Indiranagar ★★★☆☆ It's overhyped because of who has visited it. The food is average at best.
Cafe Muziris Indiranagar ★★★½☆ Another great spot for english breakfast. Do not get their pancakes though.
Zaitoon Kodihalli ★★★½☆ Their non veg dishes are great but veg not so much. The fusion dishes are a must try.
Kebapci Koramangala ★★★★★ Their kebabs are so good you'll want to eat them every day. A must try!
The Reservoire Koramangala ★★★★☆ The ambience and food is great along with live music. This one's better than Indiranagar.
Magnolia Bakery Indiranagar ★★★½☆ Their selection of desserts is great but the place is just too overhyped.
Good Flippin' Burgers Ashok Nagar ★★★☆☆ A good burger joint with a decent selection of burgers.
Khandani Rajdhani Indiranagar ★★★☆☆ Only go on Tuesdays for their rajasthani thali. The food is average.
Amicii Indiranagar ★★★½☆ Decent food but only go for the ambience and cocktails.
Bombay Brasserie Indiranagar ★★★☆☆ The food is nothing special but the place is unnecessarily expensive.
Chulha Chauki Da Dhaba Indiranagar ★★★½☆ The quantity is way too less for the price they charge. But the food is good.
Shyamji's Chole Bhature Koramangala ★★★★☆ I think these are the closest to Delhi I've had so far.
Offbeat Cafe Jayanagar ★★★★☆ Nice and small cozy cafe, I would go often if I lived nearby! They have some nice drinks 🍹
Bengaluru Cafe Jayanagar ★★★★☆ Great breakfast spot! I highly recommend visiting this.
Cafe Amudham Indiranagar ★★★☆☆ Their dosa was decent but tea was bad, maybe just a bad location :(
The Filter Coffee Indiranagar ★★★★★ Their menu and food is top tier, also a frequent spot for me. Highly recommend!
Beanlore Indiranagar ★★★½☆ I really liked the food here but the service was a bit weird. Try out their Hazelnut Latte!
Chaska Bun Indiranagar ★★★☆☆ Only go here for the Tea, Maska bun and vibes. There's no proper seating area and other items are pretty mid.
Byg Brewski Brewing Company Kaikondrahalli ★★★★☆ Great ambience and food but a pain to travel to :(
Bologna Indiranagar ★★★½☆ The food is good, but the portions don't justify the prices. Still worth visiting once in a while.
Cakewala BTM Layout ★★☆☆☆ I did not like both of the items I got. The cheesecake was so bad, I won't recommend this place.
MH12 Pavbhaji Indiranagar ★☆☆☆☆ Everything we ordered here was so bad! Please don't go here and waste your money.
Concu Indiranagar ★★★★☆ This is a great spot for co-working!
CK Vada Pav Indiranagar ★★★★★ Probably the closest to authentic vada pav and not charging exorbitant prices!
Nerlu Cafe Indiranagar ★★★★☆ The coffee and snacks are amazing here.
TWI (Taste Works) Indiranagar ★★★☆☆ This was decent, we had high hopes for Chole Bhature but it did not deliver. It's still not bad, worth it to try once.
The Bloom Cafe Jayanagar ★★★★☆ This place felt like we are in someone's home. The food and drinks were quite good, I'd definitely go back again!
Lavonne Ice Cream Kitchen Indiranagar ★★★☆☆ Naturals is way better, this place is overhyped!
Koreyaki Indiranagar ★★★½☆ The ramen is quite good here compared to most other places, deserves a visit!
Maffei Kitchen Koramangala ★★★★☆ The food here is delicious, a bit on the expensive side but totally worth it!
The Pump House JP Nagar ★★★★½ Just go for the ambience here! The food is also quite good but ambience tops it.
Chai Days Jayanagar ★★★½☆ Decent spot for late night snacks. I like their Vietnamese iced coffee.
The Hole In The Wall Cafe Koramangala ★★★★☆ Great spot for sandwiches and drinks, highly recommend.
IKEA Restaurant Bagalagunte ★★★☆☆ The meat balls that are so hyped are decent and overall food is average. They have some canned drinks which are nice though and are only available there.
Barkaas Whitefield ★★★★☆ The only thing you have to go for here is their Mandi!
Hallimane Restaurant Malleshwaram ★★★★☆ The food here is great, we went for their special mango meal which is seasonal. Definitely worth trying out once!
Paris Panini Ashok Nagar ★★★★☆ They have some great wraps, definitely worth trying once.
